text: My day starts at six-thirty. I usually get up, stretch, and drink a glass of water before taking a quick shower. By seven-fifteen, I’m at my desk, checking emails and planning my tasks. I work from nine to five, with a short lunch break around noon. After work, I go for a thirty-minute run in the park—it helps me clear my head. Back home, I cook a simple dinner and spend the evening reading or watching a series. I’m in bed by ten-thirty. Keeping this routine consistent makes my days feel steady and productive.
